title: FizzBuzz
brief: Kembalikan Fizz untuk kelipatan 3, Buzz untuk kelipatan 5, FizzBuzz untuk kelipatan keduanya, dan angkanya sendiri (sebagai teks) untuk selain itu.
starter:
CLASS lcl_fizz DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS teks
      IMPORTING iv_n          TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_teks) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_fizz IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD teks.
    rv_teks = |{ iv_n }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  DO 15 TIMES.
    WRITE lcl_fizz=>teks( sy-index ).
  ENDDO.
solution:
CLASS lcl_fizz DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS teks
      IMPORTING iv_n          TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_teks) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_fizz IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD teks.
    rv_teks = COND #( WHEN iv_n MOD 15 = 0 THEN `FizzBuzz`
                      WHEN iv_n MOD 3 = 0  THEN `Fizz`
                      WHEN iv_n MOD 5 = 0  THEN `Buzz`
                      ELSE |{ iv_n }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
tests:
CLASS ltcl_cek DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS biasa FOR TESTING.
    METHODS fizz FOR TESTING.
    METHODS buzz FOR TESTING.
    METHODS fizzbuzz FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS ltcl_cek IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD biasa.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lcl_fizz=>teks( 7 ) exp = `7` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD fizz.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lcl_fizz=>teks( 9 ) exp = `Fizz` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD buzz.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lcl_fizz=>teks( 10 ) exp = `Buzz` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD fizzbuzz.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lcl_fizz=>teks( 30 ) exp = `FizzBuzz` ).

title: Conversion exit ALPHA
brief: Buat ulang perilaku conversion exit ALPHA. to_internal menambahkan nol di depan nomor yang semuanya angka sampai panjang iv_len (default 10); teks yang mengandung huruf dibiarkan. to_external membuang nol di depan.
starter:
CLASS lcl_alpha DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS to_internal
      IMPORTING iv_value      TYPE string
                iv_len        TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING VALUE(rv)     TYPE string.
    CLASS-METHODS to_external
      IMPORTING iv_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv)     TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_alpha IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD to_internal.
    rv = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD to_external.
    rv = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  WRITE / lcl_alpha=>to_internal( `4711` ).
solution:
CLASS lcl_alpha DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS to_internal
      IMPORTING iv_value      TYPE string
                iv_len        TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING VALUE(rv)     TYPE string.
    CLASS-METHODS to_external
      IMPORTING iv_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv)     TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_alpha IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD to_internal.
    rv = condense( iv_value ).
    IF rv CO '0123456789' AND strlen( rv ) < iv_len.
      rv = repeat( val = `0` occ = iv_len - strlen( rv ) ) && rv.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD to_external.
    rv = iv_value.
    WHILE strlen( rv ) > 1 AND substring( val = rv len = 1 ) = '0'.
      rv = substring( val = rv off = 1 ).
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
tests:
CLASS ltcl_cek DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS isi_nol FOR TESTING.
    METHODS panjang_lain FOR TESTING.
    METHODS huruf_dibiarkan FOR TESTING.
    METHODS buang_nol FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS ltcl_cek IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD isi_nol.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lcl_alpha=>to_internal( `4711` ) exp = `0000004711` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD panjang_lain.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lcl_alpha=>to_internal( iv_value = `42` iv_len = 6 ) exp = `000042` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD huruf_dibiarkan.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lcl_alpha=>to_internal( `MAT-01` ) exp = `MAT-01` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD buang_nol.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lcl_alpha=>to_external( `0000004711` ) exp = `4711` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
hint: Untuk mengecek apakah semua karakter angka, pakai operator CO '0123456789'. repeat( val = `0` occ = n ) membuat n buah nol.

title: Total keranjang belanja
brief: Hitung total keranjang: jumlah qty * harga semua item, lalu beri diskon 10% kalau totalnya minimal Rp 1.000.000. Coba pakai REDUCE atau LOOP.
starter:
CLASS lcl_keranjang DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_amount TYPE p LENGTH 15 DECIMALS 2,
           BEGIN OF ty_item,
             nama  TYPE string,
             qty   TYPE i,
             harga TYPE ty_amount,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    CLASS-METHODS total
      IMPORTING it_items       TYPE tt_item
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE ty_amount.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_keranjang IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD total.
    " TODO: jumlahkan qty * harga, lalu diskon 10% kalau >= 1.000.000
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  DATA(lt_items) = VALUE lcl_keranjang=>tt_item(
    ( nama = `Kopi`  qty = 2 harga = 45000 )
    ( nama = `Gula`  qty = 1 harga = 18000 ) ).
  WRITE / |Total: { lcl_keranjang=>total( lt_items ) }|.
solution:
CLASS lcl_keranjang DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_amount TYPE p LENGTH 15 DECIMALS 2,
           BEGIN OF ty_item,
             nama  TYPE string,
             qty   TYPE i,
             harga TYPE ty_amount,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    CLASS-METHODS total
      IMPORTING it_items       TYPE tt_item
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE ty_amount.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_keranjang IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD total.
    rv_total = REDUCE ty_amount( INIT s = 0 FOR item IN it_items NEXT s = s + item-qty * item-harga ).
    IF rv_total >= 1000000.
      rv_total = rv_total * 90 / 100.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
tests:
CLASS ltcl_cek DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS kosong FOR TESTING.
    METHODS tanpa_diskon FOR TESTING.
    METHODS dengan_diskon FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS ltcl_cek IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD kosong.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lcl_keranjang=>total( VALUE #( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD tanpa_diskon.
    DATA(lt) = VALUE lcl_keranjang=>tt_item( ( nama = `Kopi` qty = 2 harga = 45000 ) ( nama = `Gula` qty = 1 harga = 18000 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lcl_keranjang=>total( lt ) exp = 108000 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD dengan_diskon.
    DATA(lt) = VALUE lcl_keranjang=>tt_item( ( nama = `Laptop` qty = 1 harga = 1200000 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lcl_keranjang=>total( lt ) exp = 1080000 msg = 'diskon 10% berlaku mulai 1.000.000' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
hint: REDUCE ty_amount( INIT s = 0 FOR item IN it_items NEXT s = s + item-qty * item-harga ) menjumlahkan semua item.

brief: Lengkapi tarik: kalau jumlah lebih besar dari saldo, lempar lcx_saldo_kurang; kalau cukup, kurangi saldonya. Jumlah nol atau negatif juga harus ditolak dengan exception yang sama.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_rekening DEFINITION.

    METHODS saldo RETURNING VALUE(rv) TYPE i.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_rekening IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_saldo = iv_saldo.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD tarik.
    " TODO
  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS lcx_saldo_kurang DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS lcx_saldo_kurang IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_rekening DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_saldo TYPE i.
    METHODS tarik IMPORTING iv_jumlah TYPE i RAISING lcx_saldo_kurang.
    METHODS saldo RETURNING VALUE(rv) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_saldo TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_rekening IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_saldo = iv_saldo.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD tarik.
    IF iv_jumlah <= 0 OR iv_jumlah > mv_saldo.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE lcx_saldo_kurang.
    ENDIF.
    mv_saldo = mv_saldo - iv_jumlah.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD saldo.
    rv = mv_saldo.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
tests:
CLASS ltcl_cek DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS tarik_cukup FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS tarik_kebanyakan FOR TESTING.
    METHODS tarik_nol FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS ltcl_cek IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD tarik_cukup.
    DATA(lo) = NEW lcl_rekening( 100 ).
    lo->tarik( 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo->saldo( ) exp = 70 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD tarik_kebanyakan.
    DATA(lo) = NEW lcl_rekening( 100 ).
    TRY.
        lo->tarik( 150 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'seharusnya lcx_saldo_kurang dilempar' ).
      CATCH lcx_saldo_kurang.
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo->saldo( ) exp = 100 msg = 'saldo tidak boleh berubah' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD tarik_nol.
    DATA(lo) = NEW lcl_rekening( 100 ).
    TRY.
        lo->tarik( 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'jumlah 0 seharusnya ditolak' ).
      CATCH lcx_saldo_kurang.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
hint: Pakai RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE lcx_saldo_kurang. Cek dulu sebelum mengubah mv_saldo, supaya saldo tidak berubah kalau ditolak.

CLASS lcl_laporan DEFINITION.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_baris,
             carrid TYPE c LENGTH 3,
             pax    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_baris,

CLASS lcl_laporan IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.

tests:
CLASS ltcl_cek DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS empat_maskapai FOR TESTING.
    METHODS garuda_teratas FOR TESTING.
    METHODS terurut FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS ltcl_cek IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD empat_maskapai.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lcl_laporan=>per_maskapai( ) ) exp = 4 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD garuda_teratas.
    DATA(lt) = lcl_laporan=>per_maskapai( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'GA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt[ 1 ]-pax exp = 435 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD terurut.
    DATA(lt) = lcl_laporan=>per_maskapai( ).
    DATA(lv_ok) = abap_true.
    DATA(lv_prev) = 999999.
    LOOP AT lt INTO DATA(ls) FROM 1.
      IF ls-pax > lv_prev. lv_ok = abap_false. ENDIF.
      lv_prev = ls-pax.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_ok msg = 'urutkan dari pax terbesar' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
hint: SELECT carrid, SUM( seatsocc ) AS pax FROM zflight GROUP BY carrid ORDER BY pax DESCENDING INTO TABLE @rt.

title: Function module PPN
brief: Lengkapi function module Z_HITUNG_PPN: dari iv_dpp hitung ev_ppn (11%) dan ev_total (DPP + PPN). Kalau iv_dpp negatif, munculkan exception klasik dpp_negatif dengan RAISE.
starter:
FUNCTION z_hitung_ppn
  IMPORTING iv_dpp   TYPE p
  EXPORTING ev_ppn   TYPE p
            ev_total TYPE p
  EXCEPTIONS dpp_negatif.
  " TODO: periksa iv_dpp, lalu hitung ev_ppn dan ev_total
ENDFUNCTION.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  DATA lv_dpp TYPE p LENGTH 15 DECIMALS 2 VALUE '1000000'.
  DATA lv_ppn TYPE p LENGTH 15 DECIMALS 2.
  DATA lv_total TYPE p LENGTH 15 DECIMALS 2.
  CALL FUNCTION 'Z_HITUNG_PPN'
    EXPORTING  iv_dpp   = lv_dpp
    IMPORTING  ev_ppn   = lv_ppn
               ev_total = lv_total
    EXCEPTIONS dpp_negatif = 1.
  WRITE: / sy-subrc, lv_ppn, lv_total.
solution:
FUNCTION z_hitung_ppn
  IMPORTING iv_dpp   TYPE p
  EXPORTING ev_ppn   TYPE p
            ev_total TYPE p
  EXCEPTIONS dpp_negatif.
  IF iv_dpp < 0.
    RAISE dpp_negatif.
  ENDIF.
  ev_ppn = iv_dpp * 11 / 100.
  ev_total = iv_dpp + ev_ppn.
ENDFUNCTION.
tests:
CLASS ltcl_cek DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_ppn TYPE p LENGTH 15 DECIMALS 2.
    DATA mv_total TYPE p LENGTH 15 DECIMALS 2.
    METHODS hitung IMPORTING iv TYPE p RETURNING VALUE(rv_subrc) TYPE i.
    METHODS satu_juta FOR TESTING.
    METHODS desimal FOR TESTING.
    METHODS negatif FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS ltcl_cek IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD hitung.
    DATA lv_dpp TYPE p LENGTH 15 DECIMALS 2.
    lv_dpp = iv.
    CLEAR: mv_ppn, mv_total.
    CALL FUNCTION 'Z_HITUNG_PPN'
      EXPORTING  iv_dpp   = lv_dpp
      IMPORTING  ev_ppn   = mv_ppn
                 ev_total = mv_total
      EXCEPTIONS dpp_negatif = 4
                 OTHERS      = 8.
    rv_subrc = sy-subrc.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD satu_juta.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = hitung( 1000000 ) exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_ppn exp = 110000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_total exp = 1110000 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD desimal.
    hitung( '250.50' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_ppn exp = '27.56' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_total exp = '278.06' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD negatif.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = hitung( -5 ) exp = 4 msg = 'DPP negatif harus RAISE dpp_negatif' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
hint: IF iv_dpp < 0. RAISE dpp_negatif. ENDIF. Lalu ev_ppn = iv_dpp * 11 / 100 dan ev_total = iv_dpp + ev_ppn.

CLASS lcl_rekap DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_rekap,
             carrid   TYPE c LENGTH 3,
             seatsocc TYPE i,
           END OF ty_rekap,

ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_rekap IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD rekap.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM zflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flight).
    SORT lt_flight BY carrid.
    LOOP AT lt_flight INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      AT END OF carrid.
        SUM.
        APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsocc ) TO rt.
      ENDAT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_booking DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS tambah
      IMPORTING iv_maskapai  TYPE c
                iv_nomor     TYPE n
                iv_tanggal   TYPE d
                iv_jumlah    TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_ok) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_booking IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD tambah.
    READ ENTITIES OF zr_penerbangan
      ENTITY penerbangan
      FIELDS ( terisi kapasitas ) WITH VALUE #( ( maskapai = iv_maskapai nomor = iv_nomor tanggal = iv_tanggal ) )
      RESULT DATA(lt_flight).
    IF lt_flight IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(ls_flight) = lt_flight[ 1 ].
    IF ls_flight-terisi + iv_jumlah > ls_flight-kapasitas.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    MODIFY ENTITIES OF zr_penerbangan
      ENTITY penerbangan
        UPDATE FIELDS ( terisi ) WITH VALUE #( ( maskapai = iv_maskapai nomor = iv_nomor tanggal = iv_tanggal
                                                 terisi = ls_flight-terisi + iv_jumlah ) )
      FAILED DATA(ls_failed).
    IF ls_failed IS INITIAL.
      COMMIT ENTITIES.
      rv_ok = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
tests:
CLASS ltcl_cek DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS terisi IMPORTING iv_connid TYPE n RETURNING VALUE(rv) TYPE i.
    METHODS tambah_tiga FOR TESTING.
    METHODS penuh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS tidak_ada FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS ltcl_cek IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD terisi.
    SELECT SINGLE seatsocc FROM zflight WHERE carrid = 'GA' AND connid = @iv_connid INTO @rv.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD tambah_tiga.
    DATA lv_nomor TYPE n LENGTH 4 VALUE '0110'.
    DATA lv_tanggal TYPE d VALUE '20261103'.
    DATA(lv_awal) = terisi( lv_nomor ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lcl_booking=>tambah( iv_maskapai = 'GA' iv_nomor = lv_nomor iv_tanggal = lv_tanggal iv_jumlah = 3 ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = terisi( lv_nomor ) exp = lv_awal + 3 msg = 'jangan lupa COMMIT ENTITIES' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD penuh.
    DATA lv_nomor TYPE n LENGTH 4 VALUE '0402'.
    DATA lv_tanggal TYPE d VALUE '20261102'.
    DATA(lv_awal) = terisi( lv_nomor ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lcl_booking=>tambah( iv_maskapai = 'GA' iv_nomor = lv_nomor iv_tanggal = lv_tanggal iv_jumlah = 50 ) exp = abap_false msg = 'kursi tidak cukup' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = terisi( lv_nomor ) exp = lv_awal ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD tidak_ada.
    DATA lv_nomor TYPE n LENGTH 4 VALUE '9999'.
    DATA lv_tanggal TYPE d VALUE '20261102'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lcl_booking=>tambah( iv_maskapai = 'GA' iv_nomor = lv_nomor iv_tanggal = lv_tanggal iv_jumlah = 1 ) exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
hint: Kalau lt_flight kosong atau terisi + iv_jumlah > kapasitas, RETURN (rv_ok tetap abap_false). Selain itu MODIFY ENTITIES OF zr_penerbangan ENTITY penerbangan UPDATE FIELDS ( terisi ) WITH VALUE #( ( maskapai = ... terisi = ls_flight-terisi + iv_jumlah ) ), lalu COMMIT ENTITIES dan rv_ok = abap_true.
